def select_next_node(current_node, destination_node, unvisited_nodes, distance_matrix):
    if destination_node in unvisited_nodes:
        return destination_node
    total_unvisited = len(unvisited_nodes)
    node_density = sum(len([n for n in unvisited_nodes if distance_matrix[current_node][n] <= 2]) for _ in unvisited_nodes) / total_unvisited
    proximity_weight = 0.7 - 0.3 * (total_unvisited / (total_unvisited + len(distance_matrix))) + 0.2 * node_density
    centrality_weight = 0.3 + 0.2 * (total_unvisited / (total_unvisited + len(distance_matrix))) - 0.15 * node_density
    lookahead_weight = 0.2 - 0.2 * (total_unvisited / (total_unvisited + len(distance_matrix)))

    def node_score(node):
        proximity = distance_matrix[current_node][node]
        centrality = sum(distance_matrix[node][n] for n in unvisited_nodes if n != node) / len(unvisited_nodes)
        lookahead = sum(1 for n in unvisited_nodes if n != node and distance_matrix[node][n] < proximity)
        return (proximity_weight * proximity) + (centrality_weight * centrality) + (lookahead_weight * lookahead)

    next_node = min(unvisited_nodes, key=node_score)
    return next_node

    total_nodes = len(distance_matrix)
    remaining = len(unvisited_nodes)
    progress = (total_nodes - remaining) / total_nodes

    proximity_weight = 0.5 + 0.3 * (1 - progress)
    lookahead_weight = 0.3 + 0.2 * (1 - progress)
    avg_weight = 0.2 + 0.2 * progress
    diversity_weight = 0.1 + 0.1 * (1 - progress)

    def node_score(node):
        proximity = distance_matrix[current_node][node]
        lookahead = sum(1 for n in unvisited_nodes if n != node and distance_matrix[node][n] < 1.2 * proximity)
        avg_nearby = sum(distance_matrix[node][n] for n in unvisited_nodes if n != node) / (len(unvisited_nodes) - 1) if len(unvisited_nodes) > 1 else 0
        diversity = len([n for n in unvisited_nodes if distance_matrix[node][n] < 1.5 * proximity])
        return (proximity_weight * proximity) + (lookahead_weight * lookahead) - (avg_weight * avg_nearby) + (diversity_weight * diversity)

    next_node = min(unvisited_nodes, key=node_score)
    return next_node

    diversity_weight = 0.2

        return (proximity_weight * proximity) + (lookahead_weight * lookahead) + (destination_weight * destination_proximity) + (diversity_weight * diversity) - (reinforcement_weight * reinforcement)

    next_node = min(unvisited_nodes, key=lambda node: calculate_weighted_cost(node))
